card.name: Digit after the dot in subsection numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 right after a section number such as 5.1, 2.1 or 7.1, at the start of a new subsection heading in a drug label. The heading title follows.

modes.label: Warnings subsections
modes.description: The 0 follows 5.1 where a warning subsection heading begins.

modes.label: Dosing or interaction subsections
modes.description: The 0 follows 2.1 or 7.1 at the start of a dosing or interactions heading.

card.plain: It marks the number that sits in a subsection heading number, just before the heading title in a drug label.
